Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 3 by misidentifying the correct Wikipedia page for Richard N. Palmer. Instead of navigating to the specific page for the Connecticut Supreme Court Justice (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_N._Palmer), the Planner incorrectly instructed the WebSurfer to open the page for "Richard Palmer (engineer)" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Palmer_(engineer)). This led to the extraction of incorrect information (British nationality) for the wrong individual, causing the entire subsequent analysis to be based on false premises. The Planner failed to verify the URL or the content of the page before issuing the instruction to extract nationality data.
